title: Page 10
content_zh:
唐忠信已经在走廊转角站了有一会儿了，他有些贪恋地欣赏妻子柔和的神情。

随着肚子一天天大起来，小悠越来越喜欢跟肚子里的孩子说话，有时甚至让他觉得自己有些被忽视了。

明明是一个还没岀生便已经开始分去他妻子关注的可恶小家，他却是如此地期盼着他的到来，无论孩子是男是女，他都真心期盼。

孩子将是他和妻子生命的延续，希望的延续。

柳悠悠结束了跟腹中小生命的交谈，慢慢身看向了走廊转角的方向。

见状，唐忠信的脸上浮上了笑，慢慢从阴影处走了出来，走向他的妻儿。

「回来了，怎么不过来？」柳悠悠问他。

「看你正和孩子说话，不想打扰你们。」

柳悠悠不由得一笑，她伸手扶在腰上。

唐忠信特别有眼色地走上前伸手扶住她，嘴里忍不住叨念，「好歹让丫鬟跟着你，不要总忘了你自己现在是个大肚婆。」

柳悠悠不以为然地笑道：「哪里便有那么娇弱了，肚子又还不大。」

唐忠信对此十分不赞同，反驳道：「哪里不大了，这肚子多明显啊。」

柳悠悠看了看自己的肚子，说：「我觉得行动好啊。」并没有特别费力的感觉。

唐忠信一时不知道自己还能说什么。

别人家的女人怀了身孕，不用别人宠，自己就能把自己宠得无法无天，搞得跟生活不能自理似的。

可为什么换到他们家情况就完全不一样了呢？

孕妇本人整天没事人似的，反倒是他这个丈夫整日担心……

但想想他家小悠从小到大的成长过程，唐忠信突然就有些明白了。

他的小悠是从小历经艰苦磨练长大的，是能和他一起并肩杀敌、将后背交给彼此的人，她从不柔弱。

「再说了，我就在院门站站，难道这也要让小果她们来扶着吗？我又不是纸扎的。」

唐忠信不知道说什么反驳她，好像说什么也说不过她，那他还是索性什么都不说了吧。

面对小悠，他总是很容易英雄气短，这还能怎办？他也只能咬牙认了。

「听说今天相府有人来，什么事啊？」他随口转了个话题，不想太为难自己。

「哦，那个啊，」说到这个，柳悠悠眼睛都笑弯了，那是发自她内心的喜悦，「义妹有喜了。」

「哦，」唐忠信闻言扬眉，然后感慨了句，「不容易啊。」

柳悠悠跟着点了点头。

自从去年遭人算计小产了，关舜华受到了不小的击，身体也跟着一直不太好，这让关义成去妇和张弘毅很担心，即使今年春闱张弘毅高中探花也没能让关舜华提起多少精神。

她原本对那出功名利禄就不怎在意，否则不会一颗心落在当初还是清贫举子的张弘毅身上。

为了让她开颜，张弘毅也着实是想了不少的法子，甚至都不惜跑来向他心中认为不怎么可靠的连襟唐忠信求教。

想起当初那个家伙一脸理所当然地对自己说「你不是很会哄女人开心吗」，唐忠信就有暴起打人的冲动。

他要是会哄女人开心，还会弄得走了许多的路才跟小悠成亲吗？

所以，他没有搭理那个不长眼的求教者，直接把他赶出了自己的书房。

「让人送礼祝贺一下就好了，你现在的身子也重了，就不要随便出门去晃了。」唐忠信忍不住多说了一句，安全起见，生产之前他都不希望她再出门。

「我知道。」柳悠悠很能理解他的心情，从善如流的表示自己不会没事找事。

唐忠信于是放下心来。

他家小悠大多时候都是让人放心的，完全不像关舜华那样没事找事，也只有张弘毅那个呆子会把关舜华当成宝贝，他真是理解不了！

唐忠信理解不了张弘毅，张弘毅也理解不了他。

这两个人事实上一直是互相嫌弃又互相伤害的，偏偏他们还是连襟，每次碰到面想回避对方都不容易，想想都郁闷。

为了隐藏自己在替皇上办事的事实，唐忠信在外的名声称不上好，这与张弘毅恰恰形成了鲜明的对比，可因为彼此的关系，自然而然地就常常会被人拿来比较。

这一比较吧，唐忠信就难免有些失意。

所以，他实在是找不到看那家伙顺眼的原因。

对干丈夫和张长弘毅的不和，柳悠悠并不太清楚，也不太在意，她觉得男人的事情有时候不能插手太深，有些事只能他们己处理。

说话间，夫妻两个进了屋子。

天气渐渐热了起来，屋里的纱帐已经挂了起来，连窗户上糊的细纱也都换成了那种轻薄透光透气的。

此时，屋里已经被丫鬟们薰过能驱蚊的药草，四周浮着淡淡的清香。

进了屋子，准备休息的柳悠悠便解了外裳随手搭到了衣架上。

为了图舒服凉快，她只穿了嫩绿的轻纱抹胸和一条只到膝盖的里裤，手臂和小腿都大刺刺地暴露在空气中。

唐忠信在一旁看得直咽口水。

自从怀孕后，妻子胸前的山峰便日渐雄伟，如今真是丰盈得让他渴望，一直显得凊瘦的身子如今也终于丰腴了些，摸起来手感非常妤，让他留恋不已。

柳悠悠拿了帕子才在自己颈上擦了下沁岀的汗，冷不防就被人从后搂住了，她瞬间就感觉到了男人的坚硬灼热，心里也是跟着一荡。

几乎是立刻的，唐忠信的吻便细细密密地朝她修长的脖颈落了下去。

柳悠悠在他怀里微侧过头，他便寻着她的唇吻了上去。

【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】

夜还很长，而他们的热情还有足够的时间燃烧。

唐大公子的妻子过世了。

他现在的妻子原本就是继室，没想到年纪轻轻便没了，很是让人唏嘘了一番。

只不过对于这件事，柳悠悠和唐忠信却是另有看法。

因为怀着身孕，夏日也不敢用太多冰，但也因为怀孕，柳悠悠特别容易出泛汗，所以唐忠信在家的时候就会时不时帮着妻子打扇子。

此时，他就正拿着一把大蒲扇在替妻子搧着风，看着她边捏了水果吃，边肯定地说：「萧王伏诛这么久了，她是该去了。」

唐忠信没有反驳，他也觉得事实确实如她所说。

对自己不忠，对家族不忠的宗妇，无论如何都是没办法留的。

柳悠悠忍不住感慨了一声，「萧王害人不浅阿。」

唐忠信默默点头。

柳悠悠继续拣了水果吃，像是一只贪吃的仓鼠。

这样的她看在唐忠信的眼中是可爱的，看她这么能吃，他的心情就特别好，这说明她肚子里的小家伙也会长得很好。

现在，小悠脸颊上的肉都多了起来，有了几分珠圆玉润的感觉。

他不明白许多男人在妻子怀孕期间移情别恋的原因，在他看来，怀孕的妻子实在是另有一种说不出来的诱人风情。

原本正专吃东西的柳悠悠察觉到了他的注视，便朝他看了过去，「怎么了？」

「没什么，」唐忠信一边给她摇扇，一边云淡风轻地道：「就是觉得你吃东西的样子也很好看。」

柳悠悠忍不住瞪了他一眼。

唐忠信不禁笑了起来，甚至还不忘举手做发誓状，「我说的是真话。」

「懒得理你。」

唐忠信丝毫不在意她的态度，迳自跟她讨论事情，「明天你也要一起过去，让小果她们跟紧些，过去略坐坐就回来吧。」

柳悠悠点了点头，「嗯，我不会为难自己的。」

像她这样身怀六里的妇人原本就不该去参加丧礼的，但是因为死的是她嫂子，她做为妯娌，好歹也该去送她这最后一程。
content_en:
Tang Zhongxin had been standing at the corner of the corridor for a while, admiring his wife's gentle expression with some greed.

As his belly gets bigger day by day, Xiaoyou likes to talk to the baby in his belly more and more, which sometimes even makes him feel a little neglected.

It was obviously a hateful little family that had begun to attract his wife's attention even before the child was born, but he was so looking forward to his arrival. No matter whether the child was a boy or a girl, he sincerely looked forward to it.

The child will be the continuation of his and his wife's life and hope.

Liu Youyou ended her conversation with the little life in her belly and slowly turned to look in the direction of the corner of the corridor.

Seeing this, a smile appeared on Tang Zhongxin's face, and he slowly walked out of the shadows and walked towards his wife and children.

"You're back, why don't you come over?" Liu Youyou asked him.

"I see you are talking to your children. I don't want to disturb you."

Liu Youyou couldn't help but smile, and she put her hands on her waist.

Tang Zhongxin stepped forward with a particularly eye-catching look and reached out to support her. He couldn't help but mutter, "At least let the maid follow you. Don't always forget that you are a pregnant woman now."

Liu Youyou smiled disapprovingly and said: "You are so delicate, and your belly is not big."

Tang Zhongxin strongly disagreed with this and retorted: "It's not big anymore. This belly is so obvious."

Liu Youyou looked at her belly and said, "I think it's good to move." It didn't feel particularly strenuous.

Tang Zhongxin didn't know what else he could say for a moment.

When a woman from another family is pregnant, she can be pampered to such an extent that she cannot take care of herself without being pampered by others.

But why is the situation completely different in their home?

The pregnant woman herself seems to be fine all day long, but her husband is worried all day long...

But thinking about his Xiaoyou's growth process from childhood to adulthood, Tang Zhongxin suddenly understood.

His Xiaoyou has grown up through hard training, and she is someone who can fight the enemy side by side with him and give each other's back. She has never been weak.

"Besides, I'm just standing at the courtyard gate. Do I need Xiaoguo and the others to support me? I'm not made of paper."

Tang Zhongxin didn't know what to say to refute her, and it seemed that nothing he could say could refute her, so he might as well say nothing at all.

When facing Xiaoyou, he is always short of breath. What else can he do?He could only grit his teeth and admit it.

"I heard that someone came to the Prime Minister's Mansion today. What's going on?" He changed the topic casually, not wanting to embarrass himself too much.

"Oh, um," Liu Youyou's eyes widened with laughter when she said this. It was the joy that came from her heart, "My adopted sister is happy."

"Oh," Tang Zhongxin raised his eyebrows upon hearing this, and then sighed, "It's not easy."

Liu Youyou nodded.

Since she was tricked into having a miscarriage last year, Guan Shunhua has suffered a big blow and her health has not been very good. This has made Guan Yicheng and Zhang Hongyi very worried. Even this spring, Zhang Hongyi was selected as the top pick in high school and could not lift Guan Shunhua's spirits much.

She originally didn't care much about fame and fortune, otherwise she wouldn't have set her heart on Zhang Hongyi, who was still a poor man.

In order to make her look good, Zhang Hongyi really thought of many ways, and even went to the extent of asking for advice from his brother-in-law Tang Zhongxin, whom he considered unreliable.

Thinking back to the time when that guy said to him "Aren't you very good at making women happy?" with a matter-of-fact expression, Tang Zhongxin felt the urge to hit him.

If he could make women happy, would he still have to go a long way to get married to Xiaoyou?

Therefore, he ignored the blind seeker and kicked him out of his study.

"Just ask someone to give you a gift and congratulate her. You are now heavier, so don't go out casually." Tang Zhongxin couldn't help but add one more thing. For safety reasons, he didn't want her to go out again before giving birth.

"I know." Liu Youyou understood his mood very well and said calmly that she would not look for trouble.

Tang Zhongxin felt relieved.

His Xiaoyou is reassuring most of the time. He is not like Guan Shunhua who is looking for trouble. Only Zhang Hongyi, an idiot, would treat Guan Shunhua as his treasure. He really can't understand it!

Tang Zhongxin couldn't understand Zhang Hongyi, and Zhang Hongyi couldn't understand him.

In fact, these two people have always disliked and hurt each other, but they are still brothers-in-law. It is not easy to avoid each other every time they meet, and it makes me depressed just thinking about it.

In order to hide the fact that he was working for the emperor, Tang Zhongxin's reputation outside was not good. This was in sharp contrast to Zhang Hongyi, but because of their relationship, they were naturally often compared with each other.

In this comparison, Tang Zhongxin is inevitably a little disappointed.

Therefore, he really couldn't find a reason to like that guy.

Liu Youyou didn't know much about the feud between her husband and Zhang Changhongyi, and she didn't care much about it. She felt that sometimes men shouldn't get too involved in men's affairs, and some things could only be handled by themselves.

While they were talking, the couple entered the house.

The weather is getting hotter, the gauze in the house has been hung up, and even the fine gauze on the windows has been replaced with something light, light and breathable.

At this time, the maids had already smoked herbs that could repel mosquitoes in the room, and there was a faint fragrance floating around.

After entering the house, Liu Youyou, who was about to rest, took off her outer clothes and put them on the hanger.

In order to stay comfortable and cool, she only wore a light green gauze tube top and a pair of trousers that only reached her knees, leaving her arms and calves exposed to the air.

Tang Zhongxin swallowed his saliva as he watched.

Since becoming pregnant, the peaks on his wife's chest have become more and more majestic. Now they are so full that he longs for them. The body that has always looked thin has finally become plumper. It feels very beautiful to the touch, which makes him nostalgic.

Liu Youyou took the handkerchief and wiped the sweat on her neck. Suddenly, she was hugged from behind. She instantly felt the man's hardness and heat, and her heart swayed.

Almost immediately, Tang Zhongxin's kisses fell thinly and densely on her slender neck.

Liu Youyou turned her head slightly in his arms, and he looked for her lips and kissed her.

[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]

The night was still long, and their passion had plenty of time to burn.

The wife of the eldest son of Tang Dynasty passed away.

His current wife was originally his step-wife, but she unexpectedly died at such a young age, which was very sad.

However, Liu Youyou and Tang Zhongxin had different views on this matter.

Because she was pregnant, she didn't dare to use too much ice in summer, but because of her pregnancy, Liu Youyou was particularly prone to sweating, so Tang Zhongxin would help his wife fan herself from time to time when she was at home.

At this time, he was fanning his wife with a big cattail leaf fan. He watched her pinch the fruit and eat it, and said with certainty: "King Xiao has been punishing her for so long, it's time for her to go."

Tang Zhongxin did not refute, and he felt that the facts were indeed what she said.

There is no way to keep a clan wife who is unfaithful to herself or the family no matter what.

Liu Youyou couldn't help but sighed, "Prince Xiao has done a lot of harm to people."

Tang Zhongxin nodded silently.

Liu Youyou continued to pick fruits and eat them, like a greedy hamster.

She looked cute in Tang Zhongxin's eyes. Seeing her eating so well made him feel very good. This meant that the little one in her belly would also grow well.

Now, there is more flesh on Xiaoyou's cheeks, and she feels a little rounder.

He didn't understand the reason why many men fell in love with their wives while they were pregnant. In his opinion, pregnant wives really had another unspeakable alluring charm.

Liu Youyou, who was eating, noticed his gaze and looked at him, "What's wrong?"

"It's nothing," Tang Zhongxin said calmly while fanning her, "I just think you look good when you eat."

Liu Youyou couldn't help but glare at him.

Tang Zhongxin couldn't help but laugh, and even raised his hands to swear, "I'm telling the truth."

"I'm too lazy to pay attention to you."

Tang Zhongxin didn't care about her attitude at all and discussed the matter with her, "You have to go there together tomorrow. Let Xiaoguo and the others follow closely. Go and sit for a while and then come back."

Liu Youyou nodded, "Well, I won't embarrass myself."

A woman like her who was six miles pregnant should not have attended the funeral in the first place, but since it was her sister-in-law who died, as a sister-in-law, she should go to see her off for the last time.
